name: What can go wrong with interior sealing on a log home?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with interior sealing on a log home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are using the wrong product, sealing over hidden moisture, or creating a finish that cannot move with the wood. Those mistakes can lead to cracking, trapped moisture, or a seal that fails again quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest risks are trapping moisture, using the wrong sealant, or choosing a product that cracks when the logs move. Proper prep and the right flexible material matter most.
